senses.gloss: तैष mf(ई)n. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 149) relating to the asterism Tiṣya, Āp.
तैष m. the month (December-January) in which the full moon stands in the asterism Tiṣya (= पौष and सहस्य), ŚāṅkhŚr. xiii, 19
तैषी f. (scil. तिथि, or रात्रि) the day of full moon in month Taiṣa, ĀśvŚr.; Gobh.; Anup.
तैसृक mfn. made in Tisṛkā, Kāt. ii, 5, 14, Sch.
